evidence.reason: Wrapped the ACP lane's post-creation setup awaits (store.appendMessage and readAcpSessionId after store.create) in try/catch blocks that rethrow as SessionBoundError(error, record.sessionId) and imported SessionBoundError alongside DispatchError, so withReapOnSettle now recognizes the lane's ownership marker and reaps the fresh session record on setup failure.
